newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda says Demio tops first-month sales target.
newsitem.headline: Mazda says Demio tops first-month sales target.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Tuesday it had received 11,200 domestic orders for its Demio compact station wagon in the first two weeks after its launch.
Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, introduced the Demio on August 26 in Japan with a monthly sales target of 4,000 units, though it expected to sell 5,000 per month in the initial period.

Mazda has not revised its production schedule since August, a spokesman said. In late August, Mazda said it would operate its Ujina No.1 plant in Hiroshima, western Japan, for an extra two days in September to raise production of the Demio.

Of total orders, the 1.3L and LX, priced between 1.05 million yen and 1.22 million yen, accounted for more than 50 percent. People in their 20s and 30s accounted for about 55 percent of buyers and women for more than 30 percent.
